title: Replace My Submissions with a dedicated Login page

requirements.text: Remove the “My Submissions” navigation entry from the header so users no longer see or access a My Submissions area from the main navigation.

quotes: Remove My submission instead try login page there

acceptanceCriteria: When authenticated or unauthenticated, the header no longer displays a “My Submissions” button/link.
No other existing nav items (Home, Articles, Admin, About, Contact) are removed or broken.

requirements.text: Add a new Login page route at /login that allows users to authenticate with Internet Identity and to log out, using the existing Internet Identity hook.

quotes: Remove My submission instead try login page there

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /login shows a login screen when the user is not authenticated, with a primary button that triggers Internet Identity login.
When the user is authenticated, /login shows the authenticated state (at minimum: a message indicating the user is logged in and a logout button).
All user-facing text on the login page is in English.

requirements.text: Disable the existing /my-submissions experience by removing the MySubmissionsPage route and ensuring /my-submissions instead takes the user to the new /login page (via redirect or by rendering the Login page).

quotes: Remove My submission instead try login page there

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /my-submissions no longer shows the My Submissions list UI.
Navigating to /my-submissions results in the Login page experience (equivalent to visiting /login).
The app builds successfully with no unused-import or route-tree errors related to removing MySubmissionsPage.

requirements.text: Update any UI that links to /my-submissions (e.g., the post-submit success state on Submit Story) to link to /login instead, with updated English button text.

quotes: Remove My submission instead try login page there

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful story submission, the call-to-action that previously navigated to /my-submissions no longer points to /my-submissions.
The updated call-to-action navigates to /login and uses clear English text (e.g., “Login” or “Account”).

constraints: Frontend files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and frontend/src/components/ui must not be edited (compose/reuse them instead).
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Reworking or redesigning the submission tracking feature beyond removing/redirecting the My Submissions page.
Changing authentication provider behavior beyond adding a dedicated login/logout UI.
Adding third-party auth providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
